goal: Prevent wallet crashes from an assertion failure during startup when the chain tip advances
Ensure confirmed transactions are not left in an inconsistent state or incorrectly abandoned
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified that delaying state updates avoids races with an advancing chain (shuv-amp)
Tested and confirmed to fix the assertion issue (dergoegge)
Noted it closes a real race where advancing chainstate triggers crashes (pablomartin4btc)
Early concerns about loop order and a CI test failure were resolved (rkrux, maflcko)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes an assertion crash during wallet startup when the chain advances
Prevents inconsistent transaction states that could allow confirmed transactions to be abandoned
